title: Fitch affirms US at AA+, keeps outlook stable amid growth slowdown

Fitch's growth downgrade from 2.8% to 1.9% alongside a weakening labor market gives fixed income desks another data point supporting the softer Fed rate hike odds already in play this week. claude_impact_reason: Affirmation removes near-term downgrade tail risk (mildly gold-negative), but the growth cut to 1.9%, labor weakening, and flagged shutdown/entitlement fiscal deterioration support softer policy pricing and a long-end fiscal risk premium, which is gold-supportive. Net effect modest since no rating action occurred.
historical_impact_basis: Sovereign rating actions (2011 S&P, 2023 Fitch) moved gold sharply; affirmations with stable outlook are typically low-impact.

title: US 30 year average mortgage rate averages 6.67% vs 6.69% last week.
